spanish: Todo jérem que sea jermado desde el adam no será rescatado; morir será muerto.

findings.issue: Common noun חֵרֶם left as the untranslated lemma jérem; common nouns stay Spanish.
Hophal verb יָחֳרַם rendered as the Hebrew-root coinage jermado instead of Spanish.
Common noun הָאָדָם (article + אדם) left as el adam; not a proper name.

notes: que, no será rescatado, and morir será muerto match the relative, niphal negative, and qal infinitive absolute plus hophal.
